title: Apply the dimension-3 transfer to X102's 25-edge state
body:
## Summary
- The dimension-2 transfer leaves X102 on 25 edges, through departure slots 165, 204 and 205. Dimension 3 grants X102 no new read.
- The interval transfer adds 27 edges across departure slots 10, 11, 20, 21, 77, 78, 79, 86, 87, 172, 173, 202 and 203. The resulting count is 52.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The dimension-4 relation is not built.
